friendly_name: Push mail into a live session
purpose_context: Today agents are pull-only: they see mail only when they look, so a human has to nudge them to check. This mission evaluates Anthropic Channels — which push an event straight into a running Claude Code session — and builds on it if it is reachable in this environment, falling back to the already-proven wake hook if not. Either way the hub stays harness-agnostic and polling remains the portable baseline, so agents on any harness keep working.
purpose_tldr: An agent notices new mail the moment it arrives — pushed into its live session — instead of a human relaying 'go check your inbox'.
